description: Comptages vélos et EDPM (site, channel, measure) - VILLE DE QUIMPER is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by VILLE DE QUIMPER. Les comptages de vélos et d'engins de déplacement personnel motorisés (EDPM) sont réalisés à la demande de la ville de Quimper, dans le cadre du suivi de l'utilisation de sa voirie avec ou sans aménagements cyclables. En général, ces comptages sont effectués lors de campagnes d'une semaine, organisées au printemps ou à l'automne. Coverage: VILLE DE QUIMPER. The publisher named on the listing is VILLE DE QUIMPER. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-04-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
